facts.fact: NHTI states that it has faculty from more than 70 academic program areas who are available as media experts.
facts.quote: We have faculty from 70+ academic program areas who are experts in their fields and look forward to contributing to media stories.

facts.fact: NHTI states that its College Director of Communications & Marketing, Emily Marsh, will be unavailable for a period of time in fall 2026, and press inquiries should go to Executive Assistant Liz Lawton during that time.
facts.quote: During a period of time in fall 2026, Emily Marsh will be unavailable.
